var.label: V_PERCPROP
var.expression: SELECT TRUNC(AD_TGFPIM.ICMS / 100,6) FROM AD_TGFPIM WHERE AD_TGFPIM.ANO = (EXTRACT (YEAR FROM :P_PERIODO.FIN)) AND AD_TGFPIM.MES = (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM :P_PERIODO.FIN))

var.label: V_PERCPROPTEXT
var.expression: SELECT TRUNC(AD_TGFPIM.ICMS,4) || ' % ' FROM AD_TGFPIM WHERE AD_TGFPIM.ANO = (EXTRACT (YEAR FROM :P_PERIODO.FIN)) AND AD_TGFPIM.MES = (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM :P_PERIODO.FIN))

grid.title: Cálculo de Proporcionalidade de Estorno de ICMS

simple-value.expression:
SELECT
SUM(T.BASEICMS) AS BASEICMS, SUM(T.VLRNOTA) AS VLRNOTA
FROM ( /*** 1 - PEGO O ICMS DE TODAS AS SAIDAS ***/ SELECT 0 AS VLRNOTA ,SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS BASEICMS
FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND PRO.NCM NOT IN (90303390,85371090,85312000) AND LIV.CODCFO IN (5101,5116,5151,5401,5910,6101,6107,6116,6118,6401,6910,5927)
UNION ALL /*** 2 - PEGO AS SAIDAS QUE TEM MANUTENCAO DE CREDITO DE ICMS ***/ SELECT CAB.VLRNOTA AS VLRNOTA ,0 AS BASEICMS
FROM TGFCAB CAB
WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFITE ITE WHERE ITE.CODCFO IN (7101,6109,7949) AND ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA )
UNION ALL /*** 3 - PEGO AS SAIDAS DE PRODUTOS NÃO BENEFICIADOS ***/ SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 1 THEN DIN.BASERED ELSE 0 END) AS VLRNOTA ,0 AS BASEICMS
FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND PRO.NCM IN (90303390,85371090,85312000) AND ITE.CODCFO IN (5101,5116,5151,5401,5910,6101,6107,6116,6118,6401,6910,6949,5927) ) T

simple-value.expression:
SELECT SUM(T.VLRICMS) AS VLRICMS, SUM(T.VLRICMS) * :V_PERCPROP AS ESTORNO
FROM ( /*** 1 - PEGO O ICMS DA ENTRADA DAS NOTAS FISCAIS NORMAL ***/
SELECT SUM(LIV.VLRICMS) AS VLRICMS FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND LIV.BASEICMS > 0 AND CAB.CODTIPOPER NOT IN (1221,1204)
UNION ALL
/*** 2 - PEGA O ICMS DO SIMPLES NACIONAL ***/
SELECT SUM(AJD.VLRICMS) AS VLRICMS FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFAJD AJD ON AJD.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND AJD.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND AJD.CODAJUSTE = 10990505 UNION ALL
/*** 3 - PEGO A DEVOLUCAO DE VENDA EXCETO NCM FORA DO REGIME ***/
SELECT SUM(LIV.VLRICMS)*-1 AS VLRICMS FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER
WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND (LIV.CODCFO IN (1201,2201,2410,1410,1208)OR TOP.CODTIPOPER = 1206) AND LIV.BASEICMS > 0 AND PRO.NCM NOT IN (90303390, 85371090,85312000)
UNION ALL /*** 4 - PEGO A DEVOLUCAO DENTRO DO PERIODO ***/
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN LIV.VLRICMS > 0 THEN LIV.VLRICMS ELSE ITE.AD_VLRICMSSP END )*-1 AS VLRICMS FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'S' AND LIV.CODCFO IN (5201,6201,6410,6410) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA WHERE C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTAORIG AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI,'MM') = TRUNC(C.DTENTSAI,'MM') ) UNION ALL /*** 5 - PEGA O ICMS NÃO ***/
SELECT SUM(AJD.VLRICMS)*-1 AS VLRICMS FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFLIV LIV ON LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
INNER JOIN TGFAJD AJD ON AJD.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND AJD.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND LIV.DHMOV >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND LIV.DHMOV <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP = 1 AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' AND AJD.CODAJUSTE = 50000999 AND AJD.CODOBSPADRAO = 123 )T
